arms.Q: trusted pre-onset base only (host poses, pre-onset keyframes)
arms.C3: the same base points + repaired post-onset frames (repository filter + FAST-LIVO2 re-run), i.e. the map the system actually holds

primary_roi.definition: the whole clean reference cloud; depends on the reference only, not on any evaluated pose

sensitivity_roi.definition: reference points within 0.5 m of the shared base map (identical in both arms, so it is a common region rather than a pose-dependent one)
